officialApp.name: Settings (AirPods settings)
officialApp.notes: Apple exposes AirPods controls and battery in the system Settings app, Control Center and the Batteries widget. There is no standalone AirPods companion app and no Android app.

battery.chargingIndicators: Case status light: green = fully charged, amber = less than one full charge; light shows bud status when the lid is open with buds inside and case status when buds are out.
battery.notes: iOS shows one combined percentage for the pair in the AirPods settings header and Batteries widget, and a separate case percentage. The case has no independent Bluetooth radio, so its reading is last-known once both buds are out; the case card is normally surfaced when the lid is opened. Apple does not publish L/R separation in the main UI.

anc.notes: No active noise cancellation or Transparency mode.

features.name: Adaptive EQ
features.notes: Automatic tuning; not a user-facing equalizer.

features.name: Automatic ear detection
features.notes: Can be turned off in Settings.

features.name: Siri head gestures (nod/shake)
features.notes: Requires Announce Calls/Notifications; availability varies by region.

gestures.action: Play/pause, next track, previous track or Siri (per-side setting)

controls.notes: Double-tap action is set separately for left and right in Settings > Bluetooth > AirPods.

audio.notes: No user equalizer in the AirPods UI. No Bluetooth multipoint; Apple Automatic Switching is the ecosystem equivalent.
